records.source: Taylor series of 1-tanh(x)/x through x^8, evaluated by Horner form.
records.variant: F5 first lateral cylindrical slosh mode
records.conditions: Use the series below this dimensionless half-depth argument to avoid subtracting nearly equal values.
records.uncertainty: First omitted term is O(x^10); below 0.001 its truncation error is below 1e-30; floating-point roundoff remains. This is an arithmetic branch, not a physical threshold.

records.variant: F5 first lateral cylindrical slosh mode
records.conditions: Inviscid first-mode mass fraction, mass station below the free surface, pendulum length and natural frequency. m0=m-m1; fixed height preserves the liquid centroid. Axial acceleration is specific force, not gravitational acceleration.
records.uncertainty: Small amplitudes and a settled cylindrical free surface. Excludes nonlinear waves, dome geometry, higher modes and the effects of baffles on inertial parameters. Not a production 6-DoF coupling certificate.

records.conditions: Equivalent viscous damping c=2*zeta*m1*omega1, or c_theta=2*zeta*m1*L1^2*omega1. The caller supplies zeta; default zero is inviscid. Carrier reaction is part of the coupled equations.
records.uncertainty: A linear equivalent for a specified tank condition; no universal damping ratio is assigned. Tank/baffle damping data and amplitude dependence are still required before production activation.

records.source: Numerical conditioning policy for the diagonally scaled Cholesky solve in Slosh6DofDynamics; 64 times binary64 machine epsilon per generalized dimension. Independent Newton/Euler conservation, free-fall and free-carrier tests constrain its supported domain.
records.variant: Constant-fill rigid-carrier and two-coordinate spherical first-mode model
records.conditions: The normalized pivot must exceed n times this budget; matrix asymmetry above the same budget is rejected. Diagonal scaling changes units, not kinetic energy. No eigenvalue clipping, artificial inertia or physical damping is introduced.
records.uncertainty: Numerical representability policy rather than a hardware parameter. An indefinite or numerically singular complete kinetic matrix is outside the supported domain even if the locked 3-by-3 inertia is positive.

records.source: Analytic derivatives of NASA SP-8009 Table I coefficients, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19690005221/downloads/19690005221.pdf ; variable-fill mechanical parameters discussed in NASA 20120010782, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20120010782/downloads/20120010782.pdf
records.variant: Smooth one-sided funded-mass intervals in an equivalent flat-bottomed cylinder
records.conditions: With lambda=rho*pi*R^2, beta=xi/(lambda*R), the modal mass is 2*tanh(beta*m)/((xi^2-1)*beta), inverse length is xi/R*tanh(beta*m), and the equilibrium station is the SP-8009 value. First and second time derivatives use the same supplied m, m_dot and m_ddot. Inverse length and mass have finite zero-mass one-sided limits; no infinite length is constructed.
records.uncertainty: Exact derivatives of the declared coefficient approximation, not validation of a coupled draining-fluid force law. The cited 2012 study explicitly notes limited validation of pendulum models for draining tanks. Flow cuts, regime transitions and momentum transfer still belong to the production adapter.
